name: Unclean Foods
overview: Scripture clearly distinguishes between clean and unclean foods, as God instructed Moses and Aaron to set apart certain animals from His people to prevent defilement (Leviticus 11:1; 20:25). Eating abominable or unclean creatures, such as swine and certain creeping things, is forbidden and carries serious consequences, including judgment (Deuteronomy 14:3; Isaiah 66:17). Jesus reinforced the importance of understanding God's commands by calling the people to hear and comprehend His teachings, emphasizing spiritual purity that aligns with God's holy standards (Matthew 15:10; Mark 7:14).
